user.title: Thermann Controller: sensor mappings
user.description: Unofficial community integration, not a Thermann product. Automatic control stays off until you commission it. Read local HA states only; no heater commands, MQTT writes or cloud requests. Optional forecast mappings: a PV forecast (EMHASS forecasts list or buffered Forecast.Solar watts) with forecast_generated_at, and a household load forecast or measured baseline.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Choose what to change. Everyday comfort settings are also available as controls on the device page. System settings, the tariff contract and the sensor mappings can only be changed while Automatic heater control is off.

sources.title: Sensor mappings
sources.description: Which Home Assistant entities the controller reads. Reading only: nothing here sends a command or contacts the cloud. Changing a mapping restarts the planner's evidence; it needs Automatic heater control off.

preferences.title: Comfort, tariff and forecast settings
preferences.description: Morning times are Hobart local and before noon; the weekend afternoon time is after noon. Tariff peak times use the tariff clock (Aurora 93: fixed AEST, so one hour later in summer) and must increase. The tariff contract can only be changed while Automatic heater control is off. Every change is checked together with the rest of the configuration; an invalid combination saves nothing.

system.title: System and commissioning
system.description: Command destination, T3 qualification, safety timing, budgets, data freshness and verification. Except for the notification service, these can only be changed while Automatic heater control is off. The command topic must be the one the bridge announced for your heater.
